play_equipment.evidence: A round dark disc with a lighter rim sits on the lawn northeast of the house, inside the outline, consistent with a trampoline.

detached_structure.evidence: A dark rectangular area at the south edge of the outline, below the house, may be a carport or outbuilding. It is partly shaded and could also be part of a neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The house has a flat or low-slope gray roof and a deck on its east side. Dense trees cover the east and north portions of the lot, and a trampoline sits in a small clearing. The lawn on the west side looks dry and patchy, with a round fire pit-like feature near the lower left.
